title: Role Assumption Chain via sts:AssumeRole
description: Principal can assume intermediate or administrative IAM roles via sts:AssumeRole.
technique_name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Temporary Elevated Privileges
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1548.005 - Temporary Elevated Privileges via STS AssumeRole

evidence.text: User or role principal has permission to call sts:AssumeRole on target IAM roles.

mitre.technique_name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Temporary Elevated Privileges

title: Overly Permissive Wildcard Role Trust Policy
description: Role trust policy allows wildcard principal assumption across accounts or unauthenticated callers.
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1098 - Account Manipulation via wildcard trust policy

evidence.text: Role trust statement permits Principal '*' without restricting conditions.

title: Dormant Administrator Account Privileges
description: Dormant user or role principal holds administrator permissions without recent activity.
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1078.004 - Inactive Cloud Accounts retaining administrative privileges

evidence.text: User is marked dormant (is_dormant=true) while holding elevated IAM privileges.

title: Sensitive Action Lacks Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Destructive or sensitive action permitted without requiring multi-factor authentication (MFA).
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1556 - Bypassing multi-factor authentication requirements

evidence.text: Destructive bucket policy action lacks aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent condition constraint.

title: Privilege Escalation via User Policy Attachment
description: Principal can attach arbitrary administrator or managed policies to IAM users.
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1098.001 - Privilege escalation via IAM user policy attachment

evidence.text: Principal holds iam:AttachUserPolicy allowing direct privilege escalation.

title: Privilege Escalation via Role Policy Modification
description: Principal can put inline policies onto IAM roles.
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1098.001 - Inline policy modification on IAM role

evidence.text: Role principal holds iam:PutRolePolicy enabling inline policy escalation.

title: Cross-Account Role Trust Misconfiguration
description: Role trusts external AWS account principal without condition constraints.
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1199 - Exploitation of cross-account trust relationships

evidence.text: Role trust statement trusts external AWS root/account ARN without ExternalId constraint.

title: Compute Service Role Passing via iam:PassRole
description: Principal can pass powerful IAM roles to compute resources (Lambda, EC2).
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1098 - Service role delegation to compute services

evidence.text: User holds iam:PassRole permission on target IAM role.

title: Compute Role Storage Data Access (Capital One Pattern)
description: Over-privileged compute role can read sensitive objects from S3 storage buckets.
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1530 & Capital One SSRF-to-S3 exfiltration pattern

evidence.text: IAM role attached to compute service has direct s3:GetObject access on sensitive buckets.

title: Direct Access to Secrets Manager Secrets
description: Role can retrieve plaintext secrets from AWS Secrets Manager.
evidence_citation: MITRE ATT&CK T1552.005 - Accessing cloud credentials stored in Secrets Manager

evidence.text: Role permits secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on production secrets.
